answer: The helix contour of the ear forms a shape profile that is unique per person and stable over time. A farm needs 260 distinct ears, since the contour depends on cartilage shape and cannot be faked. The pulse test is the price tag: 260 fakes mean 260 payments. A fresh ear image is matched to the enrolled contour each epoch. The island signal is visible to every grader, and the sonnet ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
